scope: Stored native workshop database, tenant gravuru; read-only Plesk queries. No Shopify visibility or storefront reachability measurement.
categoryOutputFilter: Only thema-, linie-, unterkategorie- category keys retained from the observed full category-count output; all retained values unchanged. Product codes and external identifiers omitted.

boundRevisionOutput.note: Stored registry bindings; no Shopify visibility or storefront reachability check.

units.activeBindingOutput: Distinct configuration IDs and Shopify product IDs from binding heads joined to their exact binding revisions. Not a join requiring current product head = bound product revision.
units.boundRevisionOutput: Distinct cfg_id + cfg_revision rows joined to the corresponding stored product revisions and current product heads. Counts refer to revision pairs, not unique products.
units.snapshot: Separate reads at 05:18 and 05:19 UTC, not one atomic snapshot or backup. One bound revision differs from its current product head; this alone does not identify the configuration causing the difference between 248 IDs and 249 revision pairs.
